siteContents.itemTitle: Not sure which storage option to choose?
siteContents.itemDescription: Figure out your storage needs in just a couple of steps.
siteContents.itemPopupTitle: How much phone storage is right for you?
siteContents.itemPopupSubTitle: How much storage space do you need for your new phone? Finding the right option might be simpler than you think.
siteContents.itemPopupDescription:
First, get a baseline of your current storage use by checking your device.

On your Samsung Galaxy, go to Settings > Battery and Device Care.
On a non-Samsung Galaxy phone, go to General > Storage.

Here, you can see how much storage is in use and how much is still free. You'll also get a breakdown of categories, like saved photos, videos, apps, music and other files.

Next, think of a typical day on your phone and whether you do a lot of storage-intensive activities.

If you don't download a lot of music and shows, or don't take many photos and videos, or if you have a lot of unused apps on your phone, then you can probably stick to a storage option similar to what you already have.

But if you love to capture every moment with your camera, spend downtime with graphics-heavy games or use your phone for work — it may be time to upgrade to a higher built-in storage size. Check the available options for your new device and choose the storage variant that's right for you.
